registered_rerun.downstream_cost_advantage_definition: factorized mean decision regret + factorized mean consolidation cost - joint mean consolidation cost

decision_rule.belief_instrument_pass: primary factorization TV exceeds both 0.01 and the paired zero-strength control by 0.01
decision_rule.action_endpoint_pass: primary factorized-vs-joint action posterior distance is at least 0.01
decision_rule.directional_utility_benefit_pass: mean factorized excess downstream cost is at least 0.001; positive means joint inference is better
decision_rule.overall_task_pass: belief instrument pass AND action endpoint pass AND directional utility benefit pass
